integrity: The all-length proof reduces to an explicit complete 64-state group-addition count; a 64-row table and two distinct standard-library verification scripts are embedded. The finite checks are not substituted for the all-length reduction. No independent external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: For the two additive abelian groups of order four and labelled proper four-colourings of K_{2,n}, n>=1, the finding classifies ordered fourfold additive energy and the resulting fourth Fourier moments, not all individual Fourier multipliers, general graph families, or other palette orders. Historical exact-table priority is not independently established.
title: Fourth-moment separation of the two abelian four-colour structures on complete bipartite graphs
